name: io.github.Doublecheese1/agentsolis
title: AgentSolis
description: Prepare unsigned USDC escrow transactions and read deal status on Arbitrum One. Never holds keys.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSOLIS_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTPS Arbitrum RPC URL. Defaults to the public arb1 endpoint. Not a credential.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSOLIS_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: arbitrum-one or arbitrum-sepolia. Defaults to arbitrum-one.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSOLIS_CONFIG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional public config URL. Defaults to the AgentSolis mainnet config.
